name: github_documented_example
description: GitHub's documented CODEOWNERS example: the last matching rule wins, an inline comment ends the owners, a later rule with no owners leaves a path unowned until an even later one owns it.

input.file:
# This is a comment.
# Each line is a file pattern followed by one or more owners.
*       @global-owner1 @global-owner2

# Order is important; the last matching pattern takes the most precedence.
*.js    @js-owner #This is an inline comment.
*.go docs@example.com
*.txt @octo-org/octocats
/build/logs/ @doctocat

# The `docs/*` pattern will match files like `docs/getting-started.md`.
docs/*  docs@example.com
apps/ @octocat
/docs/ @doctocat
/scripts/ @doctocat @octocat
**/logs @octocat

/apps/ @octocat
/apps/github

/apps/ @octocat
/apps/github @doctocat
